title: No Accountability, Unethical Service, Delivers Late, Cold Food - Then Makes you beg for resolution
text:
“I have been a Swiggy One member for a year, expecting better priority service. Unfortunately, my experience has been extremely disappointing and repeatedly poor.
I recently ordered food, but it was delivered after more than 1 hour 30 minutes—and it arrived cold and stale. When I contacted support for compensation, I was simply told to ‘write an email.’ This has happened before as well. Despite following their instructions and sending emails, the only response I received was: ‘We have noted your feedback; this will not happen again.’ Yet the same issue keeps repeating.
There is no proper accountability, no timely resolution, and no real effort to compensate customers for a genuinely bad experience. Customers are being made to run from chat support to email support without any satisfactory outcome.
Swiggy needs to improve its customer service and take responsibility for late, poor-quality deliveries. Until then, I would suggest others explore alternatives and use Swiggy only out of necessity and when there is no other option.”

title: Very unprofessional and unethical experience with Swiggy
text:
Very unprofessional and unethical experience with Swiggy.

The order was accepted and charged, and I even provided the required gate access for delivery. After all of this, I received a call saying that the order was being cancelled and was told that this was simply their “company policy.”

A company policy does not place a company above the laws of the country. No company should use the words “company policy” as a blanket justification for practices that leave customers feeling cheated after accepting their payment and obtaining the information required for delivery. Companies operate under the laws and consumer-protection rules of the country; their internal policies do not override those obligations.

It seems to have become fashionable for companies to simply say “it is our policy” as though that ends the matter. Customers deserve transparency, fair treatment, and accountability.

This entire experience was extremely unprofessional and unethical. Swiggy should take responsibility for how customers are treated rather than hiding behind “company policy.” Shame on this kind of customer service.
